# Guards read declarations

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

A guard over routes or pages reads what each one declares (a controller attribute, a route option, the page's root element) instead of a stored route table or a written-out page list, so a new correct page needs no test edit.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make page --flavor=show <Name>`.

Kit: none.
Checks: guards.declared. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Which app-wide task?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.declared-guards` to see its siblings.
